jurisdictions.name: New Orleans (Orleans Parish)
jurisdictions.office: City of New Orleans Department of Safety & Permits
notes: A swimming pool permit is required to build or alter any type of pool in the city. Applications are made online through the One Stop App.

Residential submittals include a plot plan with all lot and structure dimensions and setbacks, a signed contract or estimate, contractor licence information, and the Residential Swimming Pool Acknowledgment.
Commercial and public pools need two sets of plans with live seals from a Louisiana licensed architect or civil engineer. The page lists that seal requirement for commercial permits only.

Plan review checks the city's amendments to the International Building Code and its zoning ordinance. Pools in the Vieux Carré need Vieux Carré Commission approval, and other historic districts need Historic Districts Landmark Commission approval.
